- Initial public release of lgd-law-ethic.
- Provides a compliance gatekeeper for legal AI based on the LGD "Three Laws" (Registered, Evidenced, Gated), tailored to legal/firm/legal affairs AI applications.
- Enables deterministic self-evaluation and gating for AI systems, covering registration, evidence, and access control.
- Zero-dependency, local/offline execution. 
- Outputs structured compliance results with clear exit codes (rc=0/1/2) for easy integration and error handling.
- Not a substitute for professional legal advice; designed as a supporting compliance methodology and workflow.
